answer_4.quote: We designed our study to probe which types of LLM-generated outputs ... participants were asked to read the text the system generated ... they 1) rated how human-like the text appears to them on a five-point scale, and 2) identified why the text appears human-like ... Finally, they were asked to rewrite the text to be NOT human-like or less human-like.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated the human-likeness of each output on a five-point scale, selected the perceived anthropomorphic behaviors from a predefined list, provided open-ended explanations, and rewrote the output to reduce human-like qualities.
